name: ACT 5 - FINAL INCIDENT: Final Assessment
reason: The third client exhibits ordinary Apple services and Reddit browsing, with neither ransomware-specific pattern attributed to .131 and .134. Clean means no observed evidence of infection in this capture, not a forensic guarantee about the endpoint.

name: ACT 4 - FIRST TO LAST: Malware Attribution
reason: The FIRST TO LAST capture shows short-path POST requests and GET check-ins to /irpw/ with 2kn1=..., Connection: close, no Referer, and the fixed Firefox/39.0 User-Agent. This matches the structure of official ET Open FormBook signature SID 2050745. The rule was inspected and matched structurally; an IDS engine was not run. Public report corroboration is listed below. Do not infer a malware family solely from a shared hosting IP.
